# Mella Software Solutions PLC

> Independent software studio based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. We design, build, launch, and operate web and mobile software products for ambitious companies and in-house ventures.

## Core Products & Ventures
- **AdVouch** (https://advouch.com): An in-house live advertising marketplace with verified identity authentication, campaign escrow payments, and automated payout settlements.
- **Mizan Net**: AI-powered legal intelligence and statutory research advisor built specifically for Ethiopian legal precedents and statutory analysis.
- **School Management System**: Integrated educational ERP platform automating student records, grading analytics, and administrative operations.
- **Clinic Management System**: Clinical healthcare EHR platform managing patient electronic medical records, digital appointments, prescriptions, and billing.
- **Restaurant Management System**: Hospitality point-of-sale (POS) and real-time kitchen order dispatch (KOT) system with table inventory management.

## Capabilities & Services
- Custom Web & Mobile Application Development
- SaaS & Multi-Tenant Cloud Architecture
- AI Integration & Automated Business Systems
- Legacy System Modernization & Codebase Refactoring
- Embedded Dedicated Engineering Teams (Design, Full-Stack Engineering, Production Operations)
- Continuous Product Maintenance, 24/7 Monitoring, and DevOps

## Engineering Methodology
- **Understand**: Deep domain exploration of user problems, workflows, and constraints.
- **Build**: Integrated product design and agile software engineering with early working builds.
- **Ship**: Reliable production deployment pipelines and infrastructure management.
- **Improve**: Ongoing maintenance, feature evolution, and post-launch partnership.
